COLDWAR_COL_refresh_case = {
	COLDWAR_COL_ui_mark_dirty = yes
	# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Turkey PKK uses the existing domestic case slot.
	if = { limit = { tag = TUR COLDWAR_COL_case_target_available = no 162 = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_target = 162 } }
	if = { limit = { tag = TUR COLDWAR_COL_case_target_available = no 935 = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_target = 935 } }
	if = { limit = { tag = TUR COLDWAR_COL_case_target_available = no 1205 = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_target = 1205 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_case_target_available = no
			17 = { COLDWAR_COL_group_ira = yes is_controlled_by = PREV }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_target = 17 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_case_target_available = yes
		}
		var:COLDWAR_COL_case_target = {
		 set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_strength = COLDWAR_COL_cells }
		 set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_aid = COLDWAR_COL_local_aid }
		 set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_days = COLDWAR_COL_case_lock }
		 set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = COLDWAR_COL_case_policy }
		 if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = 0 } } set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_cost = 0.005 } }
		 if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = 1 } } set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_cost = 0.012 } }
		 if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = 2 } } set_variable = { PREV.COLDWAR_COL_case_cost = 0.02 } }
		}
	}

	COLDWAR_COL_refresh_measures_view = yes
}

COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = {
 if = { limit = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } TUR = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_refresh_aid = yes } }
 else = {

	set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_aid = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_counted_state = THIS.id }
	every_country = {
	    limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_live } }
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_live check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_state = PREV.id } }
	        if = { limit = { PREV = { is_controlled_by = var:PREV.COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_power COLDWAR_COL_contact_state = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_COL_registered_contact = yes } } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_aid = 5 } } }
	        else = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_live }
	    }
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_live check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_state = PREV.id } }
	        if = { limit = { PREV = { is_controlled_by = var:PREV.COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_power COLDWAR_COL_contact_state = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_COL_registered_contact = yes } } } PREV = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_aid = 5 } } }
	        else = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_live }
	    }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_local_aid min = 0 max = 15 }
	remove_resistance_target = 19709990
	if = {
	    limit = { COLDWAR_COL_occupation_contact = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_aid > 0 } }
	    add_resistance_target = { id = 19709990 amount = COLDWAR_COL_local_aid days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
	}

 }
}

	1080 = {
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes

	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_raf_aid = 1080.COLDWAR_COL_local_aid }
	1251 = {
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes

}

COLDWAR_COL_send_local_political = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_support_target check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target < 5000 }
		}
		var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } TUR = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_refresh_aid = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_group_raf = yes }
			}
			GER = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_raf_aid = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_can_local_political = yes
		}
		add_political_power = -15
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_political_cooldown days = 180  value = 1 }
		var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					COLDWAR_COL_group_raf = yes
				}
				GER = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_milieu = 2 } clamp_variable = { var = cwger_raf_milieu min = 0 max = 100 } }
			}
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } TUR = { add_to_variable = { TUR_PKK_strength = 5 } clamp_variable = { var = TUR_PKK_strength min = 0 max = 100 } COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_reconcile = yes } }
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						COLDWAR_COL_group_ira = yes
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_cells = 5 }
				}
				else = {
					add_compliance = -3
				}
			}

			COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_group_raf = yes }
			}
			GER = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_raf_aid = yes COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_gui_refresh = yes }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } TUR = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_refresh_aid = yes } }
		COLDWAR_COL_disclose_political = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_send_local_arms = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_support_target check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target < 5000 }
		}
		var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } TUR = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_refresh_aid = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_group_raf = yes }
			}
			GER = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_raf_aid = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_can_local_arms = yes
		}
		add_political_power = -15
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_weapons_type amount = -250 }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = cnc_equipment_type amount = -25 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_cooldown days = 180  value = 1 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_live days = 180  value = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_state = COLDWAR_COL_support_target }
		var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { controller = { set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_power = THIS } } }
		var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					COLDWAR_COL_group_raf = yes
				}
				GER = { add_to_variable = { cwger_raf_cadre = 1 } clamp_variable = { var = cwger_raf_cadre min = 0 max = 120 } }
			}
			else_if = { limit = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } TUR = { add_to_variable = { TUR_PKK_strength = 3 } clamp_variable = { var = TUR_PKK_strength min = 0 max = 100 } COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_reconcile = yes } }
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						COLDWAR_COL_group_ira = yes
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_cells = 3 }
				}
				else = {
					add_resistance = 5
				}
			}

			COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_group_raf = yes }
			}
			GER = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_raf_aid = yes COLDWAR_GER_1970_sec_gui_refresh = yes }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } TUR = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_refresh_aid = yes } }
		COLDWAR_COL_disclose_arms = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_domestic = {
	COLDWAR_COL_ui_mark_dirty = yes
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_construction = COLDWAR_COL_cells }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_construction = -0.001 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_resources = COLDWAR_COL_cells }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_resources = -0.0005 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_workforce = COLDWAR_COL_cells }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_workforce = -0.0005 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = 2 } } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_construction = -0.05 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_workforce = -0.02 } }
	COLDWAR_COL_measures_local_restrictions = yes
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_domestic_security } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_domestic_security } }
}

COLDWAR_COL_contacts_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_contacts_scenario = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = ENG
			}
			remove_ideas = ENG_ulster_flashpoint
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = ENG_1985_ira_state_initialised
				}
				17 = { force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = ENG } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_ira_troubles_state_modifier } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_ira_static_modifier } }
				clr_country_flag = ENG_1985_ira_state_initialised
			}
		}
		17 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_controlled_by = PREV
					COLDWAR_COL_group_ira = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ira_initialized }
					}
					set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ira_initialized
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_cells = 35 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = 0 }
				}
				COLDWAR_COL_apply_domestic = yes
			}
		}

		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_case = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_contacts_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_contacts_scenario = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = ENG
			}
			remove_ideas = ENG_ulster_flashpoint
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = ENG_1985_ira_state_initialised
				}
				17 = { force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = ENG } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_ira_troubles_state_modifier } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = ENG_ira_static_modifier } }
				clr_country_flag = ENG_1985_ira_state_initialised
			}
		}
		17 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_controlled_by = PREV
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						COLDWAR_COL_group_ira = yes
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ira_initialized }
						}
						set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ira_initialized
						set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_cells = 35 }
						set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = 0 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_lock > 0 }
						}
						subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_lock = 1 }
					}
					COLDWAR_COL_apply_domestic = yes
				}
				else = {
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_domestic_security }
				}
			}
		}

		COLDWAR_COL_measures_daily = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_state check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_state > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_state < 5000 }
			}
			var:COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_state = { if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_live }
				}
				clear_variable = COLDWAR_COL_local_funding_state
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_state check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_state > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_state < 5000 }
			}
			var:COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_state = { if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_live }
				}
				clear_variable = COLDWAR_COL_local_arms_state
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_support_target check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target < 5000 }
				COLDWAR_COL_contact_target_available = no
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_support_panel_open
		}

		# COLDWAR | hand patch 07.11.2026 (performance): only countries with a support target walk the 44 target checks; the rest get the same zero values.
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_support_target check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target > 0 } }
			COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_resistance = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_index = 0 }
			COLDWAR_COL_refresh_contacts_view = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_case = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_contacts_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_contacts_scenario = yes
		}
		17 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					COLDWAR_COL_group_ira = yes
					is_controlled_by = PREV
				}
				COLDWAR_COL_measures_initialize = yes
				COLDWAR_COL_refresh_local_aid = yes
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_drift = 1 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_drift = -0.5 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_policy = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_case_drift = -1 } }
				COLDWAR_COL_measures_ira_monthly = yes
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_cells = COLDWAR_COL_case_drift }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_aid_drift = COLDWAR_COL_local_aid }
				multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_aid_drift = 0.1 }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_cells = COLDWAR_COL_aid_drift }
				clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_cells min = 25 max = 90 }
				COLDWAR_COL_apply_domestic = yes
				COLDWAR_COL_measures_incident = yes
			}
		}

		COLDWAR_COL_measures_country_monthly = yes
	}
}

}

COLDWAR_COL_refresh_contacts_view = {
	COLDWAR_COL_ui_mark_dirty = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = COLDWAR_COL_support_target check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target > 0 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target < 5000 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_group = 0 }
		if = { limit = { COLDWAR_COL_contact_target_available = yes var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_group = 103 } }
		if = {
		    limit = { COLDWAR_COL_contact_target_available = yes }
		    var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = {
		        set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_resistance = THIS.resistance }
		        if = { limit = { COLDWAR_COL_occupation_contact = yes } set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = COLDWAR_COL_local_aid } }
		        if = { limit = { COLDWAR_COL_domestic_contact = yes } set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_cells } set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = COLDWAR_COL_local_aid } }
		    }
		}if = {
			limit = {
				var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_group_ira = yes }
				COLDWAR_COL_contact_target_available = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_group = 101 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_group_raf = yes }
				COLDWAR_COL_contact_target_available = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_group = 102 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_COL_group_raf = yes }
				COLDWAR_COL_contact_target_available = yes
			}
			GER = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_raf_aid = yes }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_resistance = GER.cwger_raf_cadre }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = GER.COLDWAR_COL_raf_aid }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_raf_milieu_view = GER.cwger_raf_milieu }
		}
	}

if = { limit = { COLDWAR_COL_contact_target_available = yes var:COLDWAR_COL_support_target = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_group = yes } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_resistance = TUR.TUR_PKK_strength } set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = TUR.COLDWAR_TUR_1970_PKK_aid_cap } }
}

# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Security Affairs access guidance. Generated by tools/colonial_affairs/security.py.
COLDWAR_COL_next_contact = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_COL_contacts_scenario = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_next_id = 100000 }
		every_state = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_COL_foreign_contact_visible = yes }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_browse_id = THIS.id }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_browse_id value = ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_target compare = greater_than } check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_browse_id value = ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_next_id compare = less_than } } set_temp_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_next_id = THIS.id } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_next_id = 100000 }
			}
			every_state = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_COL_foreign_contact_visible = yes }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_browse_id = THIS.id }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_browse_id value = ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_next_id compare = less_than }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_next_id = THIS.id }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_next_id < 100000 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target = COLDWAR_COL_next_id }
			COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
		}
	}
}
